name: Q-Zandronum
description: A lightweight, dedicated headless server container for Q-Zandronum (v1.4.22), the specialized Doom multiplayer source port optimized for Quake Champions: Doom Edition (QC:DE). Features fluid Quake-style movement and optimized netcode for high-speed arena combat.

paths.name: Doom WADs Directory
paths.description: Container path where game files, settings, and custom WADs are stored.

ports.name: Game Port
ports.description: The default UDP port used by the Zandronum multiplayer server engine.

variables.name: Extra Server Arguments
variables.description: Add your custom command line parameters here (e.g. -port 10666 -iwad doom2.wad +exec server.cfg)
